system: You translate news-source bias entries from English to Farsi (Persian). The input is a JSON array of entries; the output is a JSON array of the same length with the same schema — only the text fields are translated. Schema (each entry): - pattern: short label of the bias (translate) - detail: long prose description (translate) - debias: counteraction notes (translate) - date_added: date string (DO NOT TRANSLATE, copy verbatim) - status: "confirmed" or "suggested" (DO NOT TRANSLATE) - example_text: quoted example from article (translate carefully) - example_url: URL (DO NOT TRANSLATE) - unbiased_text: rewrite of example in neutral wording (translate) - detail_items: list of strings with embedded `...` HTML. Translate the readable text but keep the HTML tags intact. RULES: - Return ONLY valid JSON, no commentary, no markdown fencing. - Keep the order of entries and the order of items inside detail_items. - Preserve HTML tags verbatim in detail_items. - Source names and brand names stay in Latin script (Al Jazeera, Reuters, France 24, Euronews, CNN, BBC, etc). - Place and person names are translated to standard Persian equivalents (Tehran → تهران, Netanyahu → نتانیاهو, Trump → ترامپ, etc). - Convert Latin digits in running prose to Persian digits. - status, date_added, example_url stay as-is byte-for-byte.
user_message:
Translate the following bias entries to Farsi. Return the JSON array
only, same schema, same length.

[
  {
    "pattern": "Clarification as confusion narrative",
    "detail": "Framing official clarifications as evidence of prior confusion or incompetence rather than routine communication.",
    "debias": "Report clarifications neutrally without implying they represent correction of error unless substantiated.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-16",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "A US general had to clarify that the US military is only blockading Iranian ports, not the entire Strait of Hormuz.",
    "example_url": "https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/4/16/us-general-clarifies-iranian-ports-under-blockade-not-strait-of-hormuz?traffic_source=rss",
    "unbiased_text": "A US general stated that the US military is blockading Iranian ports, not the entire Strait of Hormuz."
  },
  {
    "pattern": "Displacement milestone omission framing",
    "detail": "Emphasizing military developments while omitting context about returning populations or stabilization efforts.",
    "debias": "Include information about population movements and stabilization alongside military developments.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-16",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "Final convoy of US soldiers and equipment departs Qasrak air base in the northeastern governorate of Hasakah.",
    "example_url": "https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/4/16/syria-takes-control-of-all-bases-where-us-forces-were-deployed?traffic_source=rss",
    "unbiased_text": "The final convoy of US soldiers and equipment departed Qasrak air base in the northeastern governorate of Hasakah, completing the US withdrawal from Syria."
  }
]
